summary.scope: All44 formal V2.1 reconstruction and V2.2 fixed-H comparison records, no smoke/supplemental tests.
summary.category_rule: Terminal stage first where logged. V2.2 three logged build timeouts are blender_build_timeout and also have scene_deadline_limited=true. V2.1 no stage telemetry: total_budget_exceeded with substage unresolved.
summary.statistical_unit: Scheduled reconstruction attempt; repeated H/runs are not independent natural scenes.

rows.evidence_summary: The CLI completed. Blender subprocess timeout was capped by the scene deadline remainder; total recorded runtime was approximately 600 seconds. No pre/post-build telemetry exists. All failed steps lack scene.blend and final.png; because render.py saves before rendering, timeout appears pre-render, but startup/build/validation/device-setup/save cannot be separated.
rows.limitations: No stage telemetry and empty Blender stdout/stderr. Pre-render is inferred from no saved blend; exact startup/build/device/save substage unknown.

rows.evidence_summary: Two execution attempts failed: invalid fillet radius, then absent World. Third complete code response was not executed because the common execution allowance was already spent.
rows.limitations: Generated-program errors confirmed; no time deadline reached. No useful saved blend.

rows.evidence_summary: First model succeeded; build ran 422.34 seconds and ended with absent World. The repair CLI then received only 82.246529 seconds from the remaining 600-second scene deadline.
rows.limitations: Repair CLI cause beyond deadline unknown: its JSONL contains only thread.started and turn.started, with no network error. Do not call this a proven provider failure or a standalone 300-second model cap.

rows.evidence_summary: Executable scene and visual metrics saved.
rows.limitations: Natural-image reconstruction has no three-dimensional ground truth.

rows.evidence_summary: First CLI hit its approximately 300-second cap; actual events show Connection refused and repeated waiting for network. No scene program executed.
rows.limitations: Transport/connectivity fault evidence is direct. Provider/root network cause and remote inference time remain unknown.

rows.evidence_summary: First build ran 391.64 seconds then failed on absent World.color. A successful second model response left only 29.734320 seconds for the second build, which timed out before build_completed.
rows.limitations: Timed-out build substage is unknown. The first build completed 22 Boolean operations, but that does not prove the final timeout was in a Boolean or explain all construction time.
